hextech_lib.card.test.common_feather.des: Common preview: a feather icon. This card grants no gameplay effects.
hextech_lib.card.test.common_shield.desc: Common preview: check the shield model, border and hover highlight.
hextech_lib.card.test.common_bread.title: A Small Supply for the Next Adventure
hextech_lib.card.test.common_bread.descr: A deliberately long common-card title and description for testing text wrapping, truncation and the full tooltip. Choosing or removing this card does not change your inventory or attributes.
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_emerald.title: Emerald Spark
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_emerald.descr: Rare preview: compare the emerald icon with the green rarity accent.
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_boots.title: Explorer's Stride
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_boots.descrip: Rare preview: inspect the boots icon and keyboard focus outline. No movement bonus is applied.
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_compass.title: A Compass Pointing Beyond the Horizon
hextech_lib.card.test.rare_compass.descr: Rare preview with a long title. Hover or focus this card to read the entire description; selecting it has no gameplay effects.
hextech_lib.card.test.epic_amethyst.desc: Epic preview: a bright crystal against the purple card accent.
hextech_lib.card.test.epic_pearl.title: Void Traveler
hextech_lib.card.test.epic_pearl.descrip: Epic preview: check entrance and hover transitions. This pearl does not teleport you.
hextech_lib.card.test.epic_book.title: The Unfinished Grimoire of Endless Possibilities
hextech_lib.card.test.epic_book.descript: Epic preview with a long title and an enchanted-book icon. Use it to inspect wrapping, tooltip placement and enchanted item rendering. No enchantments or attributes are granted.
hextech_lib.card.test.legendary_star.des: Legendary preview: a nether star framed by a golden rarity accent.
hextech_lib.card.test.legendary_totem.de: Legendary preview: test choosing and giving up a card. This totem does not prevent death.
hextech_lib.card.test.legendary_elytra.t: Wings That Carry You Across the Starry Sky
hextech_lib.card.test.legendary_elytra.d: Legendary preview with a long title and description. Open the collection after choosing several cards to inspect scrolling and focus navigation. No flight ability or item is granted.
